curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach what each yellow and white line pattern allows or forbids, from single solid yellow to double solid white, broken lines and yield triangles.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per marking rule; contrast cards for single versus double yellow and double white versus oversized broken white.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz that names a line pattern and asks whether you may cross or pass.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain lane numbering and which lanes serve passing, turning, entering and exiting, the lane change routine, then HOV lanes, center turn lanes and turnouts.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for lane choice, lane changes, HOV lanes and center turn lanes; contrast cards for HOV versus center turn lane use.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz that names a move and asks which lane or lane rule applies.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover bike lane rules and bikeway types, then how to set up and finish a right turn, where to stop, right on red, red arrows and bus lanes.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for bike lane use and each right-turn rule; contrast cards for right on red versus red arrows.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a right turn near a bike lane or signal.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach dedicated right-turn lanes, the left-turn routine, left on red, where U-turns are allowed and banned, and the turn diagrams for two-way and one-way streets.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each turn rule; contrast cards for allowed versus banned U-turn spots and for the diagrammed lanes.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz that names a street layout and asks where the turn starts and ends.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Finish the one-way and T-intersection diagrams, then braking smoothly, merging onto and exiting from highways.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for the diagrams, braking, merging and exiting; contrast cards for merge versus exit signal timing.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz that swaps the merge and exit seconds and distances.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain how much room you need to enter traffic in town and on highways, where passing is banned, the passing routine, and what to do when someone passes you.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for gaps, passing bans and the passing steps; contrast cards for town versus highway gaps.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz giving a road situation and asking whether passing or entering is safe.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Walk through parallel parking, straight-line backing, hill parking wheel positions, curb colors and the never-park list.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each parking skill and rule; contrast cards for the hill wheel positions and the curb colors.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz that names a curb color, slope or distance and asks what is allowed.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover emergency and freeway parking, what to do when stopped by law enforcement, searches and documents, recording officers, and filing a complaint.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each stop and rights rule; contrast cards for declining versus resisting a search.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a traffic stop and asking what the driver should do.

learning_path_rule.rule: module order sec06-m01..sec06-m08; component facts before the synthesis (R) nodes that contrast them; no dynamic nodes exist

node_types.definition: one accepted handbook fact as an atomic node
one accepted C2 contrast fact joining the component facts it names

edge_types.definition: component fact must be learned before the contrast or dependent fact

sequencing.rule: module order, then component facts before synthesis nodes
